name: American Election
source:
A dark political nightmare game about Abigail Thoreau, a campaign assistant working to elect her candidate.

[From [url=https://gregbuchanan.itch.io/american-election]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款陰暗的政治惡夢遊戲。你將走進競選助理阿比蓋爾．梭羅的故事，她正在幫助自己的候選人贏得選舉。

［摘自[url=https://gregbuchanan.itch.io/american-election]Itch.io[/url]］
